newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Berserk man kills 10 in Pakistan-held Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Berserk man kills 10 in Pakistan-held Kashmir.

text.p: Ten people were killed and four wounded in Pakistani-held Kashmir when a man went on a shooting spree after arguing with his nephew about felling a tree, police said on Monday.

They said the shooting, in which eight members of one family and two men who had tried to mediate died, took place late on Saturday in Hussain Kot village, near Rawalakot, 130 km (80 miles) south of Muzaffarabad, capital of Azad (free) Kashmir.
The killer, identified an agriculture department driver, gave himself up to police.
